name: Gorou Sano
source: Sano is a substitute teacher at Miyanomori High School. He has a keen interest in all young women and due to a prank love letter made by [url=https://vndb.org/c63681]Daisuke[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c63686]Yumiko[/url], he fell in love with [url=https://vndb.org/c63690]Takuya[/url]. Little does he realize that Takuya's actually [url=https://vndb.org/c63689]a man[/url]. He just might find that out a little too late.
